verdict.rationale: Teller sends webhook events when conditions or changes are detected in enrollments or financial data, configured from the Dashboard. A developer can use these as triggers and build their own logic, for example calling the payments API. Teller itself offers no way to define rules or automatically trigger actions; that logic must live in the customer's own app. Missing for 10: a native rules or automation engine, configurable event-to-action mappings, documentation of event types and filters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
